fact.title: Notice period is set by your contract
fact.claim: No central law fixes the notice period in a private job. Your contract fixes it.
fact.law: Delhi: one month's written notice after 3 months of service. Other states differ.

script.cover_1: You resign, and your manager says a longer notice applies.
script.payoff: Reports say the contract fixes the notice period, not the manager.
script.caption: Notice is a term in the contract you signed on day one. Send this to the friend who is planning to resign.
script.situation: Can your manager demand a longer notice than your offer letter says?
script.answer: Reports say no central law fixes private notice periods. Your contract does, so the clause matters.
script.reply_me: Could we read the notice clause in my signed contract together? I want to stay within it.
